requirementSections.heading: Supporting Courses and Related Areas

rules.commentRaw: Select 6 credits of 1 to 400-level ARTH courses, except ARTH 100
Select 6 credits of 400-level ARTH courses; ARTH 495 may not be used to satisfy this requirement.
Note: Students are encouraged to use these supporting courses to focus their studies in one or two areas of art history and should discuss these course selections with an Art History faculty member.
